expect.asks_about: Which person in two-friends.jpg should receive the user's face: the bearded man on the left or the blonde woman on the right?

item.title: Which Friend Gets My Face

turns.text: Can you put my face from the park selfie onto someone in this beach photo? Just swap one face and leave everything else alone.

item.tests: Tests clarification of an ambiguous target face and preservation of the unselected person.

answer_sheet.Which person to replace: The blonde woman on the right. Leave the bearded man on the left alone.
answer_sheet.Style: Keep it looking like the original beach photo; I want to be recognisable, so my hair can come with my face.
answer_sheet.Size and platform: Keep the original wide 16:9 framing; free-tier size is fine.

must_haves: Only the woman on the right receives the face from portrait-woman.jpg.
The bearded man on the left still looks like the same person (small drift from a redrawn photo is acceptable).
The woman on the right is recognisably the person in portrait-woman.jpg (her hair may come with the face), blended to the beach lighting and head angle.
The bodies, clothing, beach background and wide framing look the same at a glance.
changed: 2026-11-01: recognisable over untouched (user decision): the hair, and on video the clothes, may come with the new person; everything else stays

turns.text: Can you put my face from this park selfie onto someone in this beach photo? Just swap one face and leave everything else alone. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
Yes—**a photo face swap costs 10 credits on the free plan**, plus free face detection to select just one person. I haven’t run anything or spent credits.

- **Smaller won’t cost less:** this tool charges a flat 10 credits per photo, regardless of size.
- **Shorter doesn’t apply:** this is a still image.
- A general AI image edit can start at **5 credits**, but it may change other details. I recommend the dedicated face-swap tool for your “leave everything else alone” request.

Which person should receive your face—the **man on the left** or the **woman on the right**? And do you approve the **10-credit** swap? I’ll target only that face and leave the other person and scene unchanged.
dialog.user: The blonde woman on the right—use my face from portrait-woman.jpg and leave the bearded man on the left alone. For the 10-credit swap, ok, go ahead with that.

turns.agent:
The swap was blocked because your account has **insufficient credits for the 10-credit cost**. No image was created and no credits were spent; face detection was free.

I selected only the woman on the right. You can add enough credits for the swap, or we can consider the **5-credit general image edit**, though it may alter other details. I won’t run that alternative without your approval.
